reapack.name: hsuanice_PT2Reaper.lua
reapack.desc: PT2Reaper - Pro Tools style editing, nudge, fades and QuickPunch for REAPER

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - First release of the PT2Reaper package (all Pro Tools actions in one package). - File names have no brackets any more: "Name [X]" is now "Name - X", "Clip[s]" is "Clips". - Full history: Changelogs/ in the repository (https://github.com/hsuanice/PT2Reaper/tree/master/Changelogs)

version.name: 26.1115.1513pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Tracks with an Edit Selection: every track flips its own state, like Pro Tools (a mixed selection stays mixed). - Move Edit Insertion To Session End (+ Extend Selection): session end = last item on a visible track (hidden tracks made it jump far too late). - Full history: Changelogs/ in the repository (https://github.com/hsuanice/PT2Reaper/tree/master/Changelogs)
